title: Decide default app-data storage locations
description: Resolve the post-MVP distribution decision for default user storage paths. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r. Loreweaver currently requires LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH and documents that no default app-data directory is settled. Decide the per-platform default root for campaign SQLite files, checkpoint repos, managed Dolt cache, config/env templates, and release-package static content, or explicitly keep the required-path MVP behavior for the first distribution.
acceptance_criteria: Decision is recorded in docs or an ADR; it names per-platform defaults or explicitly keeps LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH required for the first distribution; README/docs/storage.md are updated to remove the unresolved-gap wording when the decision is made.
close_reason: Recorded ADR 0003 keeping first-release CLI storage explicit via LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH, updated README/storage/distribution docs, and filed follow-up loreweaver-d4r.2 for future config-file and campaign-registry defaults; verification: npm run typecheck and npm run test passed.
